title: The coord hook reads announce.to_other_sessions from an invalid settings.json by the first such key in the text, so an unrelated earlier key outside coordination.announce beats the real false and the intent is posted
goal: the coord hook's fallback read of announce.to_other_sessions from an invalid settings.json takes the key under coordination.announce, not the first such key anywhere in the file

run:
import importlib.util,tempfile,os,sys
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ch",".claude/hooks/coord_hook.py");m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
open(os.path.join(d,"settings.json"),"w").write("{\"other\": {\"to_other_sessions\": true}, \"coordination\": {\"announce\": {\"to_other_sessions\": false,},},}")
sys.exit(0 if m.settings(d)[0]["to_other_sessions"] is False else 1)
